According to the site, he was shot near a casino in Hollywood, Florida.In a statement that didn't name the rapper, the Seminole Police Department said an "incident" happened in the valet area outside the Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood. One person was taken to Memorial Regional Hospital in Hollywood with non-life-threatening injuries, the department said. RecommendedCulture & TrendsCulture & TrendsThe 'Mormon Wives' are headed west.
